params.colormode_help: Color preserves the hues of the image; binary reduces everything to two tones (ideal for laser cutting).
params.invert_help: Inverts blacks and whites before tracing — useful for a dark logo on a light background.
params.hierarchical_help: Stacked keeps overlapping layers (accurate rendering); cutout produces non-overlapping shapes (vinyl cutting).
params.color_precision_help: Number of color bits: fewer bits = fewer colors and a lighter SVG.
params.layer_difference_help: Minimum color difference between two layers: larger = fewer layers.
params.mode_help: Spline: smooth curves. Polygon: straight segments. Pixel: one square per pixel (pixel art style).
params.filter_speckle_help: Ignores areas smaller than this size (in pixels) to eliminate noise.
params.corner_threshold_help: Angle below which a vertex is smoothed: 0° keeps all angles, 180° rounds everything.
params.length_threshold_help: Minimum length (in pixels) below which segments are merged into curves.
params.splice_threshold_help: Angle below which two paths are joined at a single point.
params.max_iterations_help: Curve refinement passes: higher = smoother, slower.
